[1/1] Fix Coulomb orbital elements and inert time-scale flags reported by the orrery reforge audit

impact_assessment.why: Reforge found that info/--json computed osculating elements from gravity alone for charged scenarios, and that snapshot/export advertised --time-scale although both ignored it.
impact_assessment.benefits: Correct circular Bohr orbits and honest unbound Rutherford elements; single-shot commands no longer advertise an inert flag; regression tests cover both fixes.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: CLI info --json element values change for charged scenarios, and snapshot/export reject --time-scale; dependency: none added; concurrency: none; state: no persisted format changes.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Regression tests for Coulomb attraction/repulsion and for rejecting the removed flag; full suite, Ruff and the project check run before the commit.

[1/1] Apply the Coulomb-aware orbital elements to the web scenario payload

impact_assessment.why: The stage-16 review found that orrery/web.py still called orbital_elements(primary, b, scenario.g), so /api/scenario/<key> kept the wrong elements for charged scenarios and ignored a k_coulomb override.
impact_assessment.benefits: The browser studio and the CLI now describe charged scenarios with the same effective two-body parameter; the web payload honors its own k_coulomb option.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: web /api/scenario numeric elements change for charged scenarios; dependency: none; concurrency: none; state: no format change.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Add a web regression test for the scenario k_e and an override, then run the full suite, Ruff and the project check.
